images.prompt: A complete high-fidelity Dike enterprise finance web app design proposal. Single flat desktop screen 1536x1024, no device frame, no perspective. Calm refined professional product UI, precise readable text, implementable in ASP.NET Razor Pages. New coherent design system: fixed 224px ink navy #142B3D sidebar, light cool neutral #F6F8FB workspace, pure white #FFFFFF table surfaces, deep teal #127A71 primary actions, small bronze #A57545 brand accent, grey #DCE3EB rules, amber discrepancy treatment with text. Lowercase 'dike' wordmark retains a small bronze d. monogram. Inter/Source Sans-like 14px UI text, 28px sans headings, tabular aligned SAR amounts, 8px geometry. No hero, gradients, generic KPI card grid, ornamental charts, photos, nested cards, huge headline, decorative pills or irrelevant features. Slim consistent outline icons only for navigation/actions. Tables and open ruled sections are main layout. Topbar 60px with fixed 'Example Company' identity (no company dropdown), right language control and avatar. Place 'Design preview · synthetic data' in the topbar as a simple small disclaimer. Sidebar has Overview, Accounts, Reconciliation, Review, Exceptions, Workpapers; lower separated section Connections, Imports, Team & access, Company. No other top-level items. Footer small 'Dike review does not change accounting records.' Screen: full Account overview, Accounts active. H1 'Accounts overview' with supporting 'November 2026 · SAR' and a restrained 'Import activity' action. Compact period toolbar with Monthly selected, Weekly and Custom dates alternatives; period 'November 2026'. Show two account rows in a spacious full-width white table with columns Account / Accounting source / Bank coverage / Ledger coverage / Period difference / Next action. Row1 'Operating account · 118', source Odoo, both coverage 'Complete · 1–30 Nov', difference '−50.00 SAR' amber, action 'Compare'. Row2 'Reserve account · 119', source Odoo, Bank 'Not imported', Ledger 'Limited sample', difference 'Not available', action 'Review sources'. Under row1 expand open detailed facts: 'Bank booked movement 7,550.00 SAR', 'Odoo posted movement 7,600.00 SAR', 'Period difference −50.00 SAR'. Label explicitly 'Period movement, not account balance'. Below broad two-column area, left two-thirds 'Needs attention' with three ruled worklist rows: 'Operating account · Unexplained SAR 50 difference' / 'Reserve account · Bank statement missing' / 'Reserve account · GL preview is not complete evidence'. Right third compact source history 'Latest source activity' with two timeline entries 'Bank statement imported · 17 Nov, 18:40' and 'Odoo GL captured · 17 Nov, 18:42', timezone 'Asia/Riyadh'. Quiet text below 'Full reconciliation requires complete source coverage.' Bottom open strip 'Next review steps' with Compare → Prepare → Independent review → Workpaper. Whole screen legible and carefully balanced; no invented totals beyond exact supplied amounts. Sample target-state proposal, not a live financial dashboard.
